Package model.filesystem

Class SuperBlock

java.lang.Object
model.filesystem.SuperBlock
public class SuperBlock extends Object
Represents the super block of the Unix-style file system model.

The super block centralizes global file system metadata, including capacity, inode availability, block availability, creation time, modification time, mount count, and dirty state. It delegates allocation tracking to InodeBitmap and BlockBitmap.

This class is responsible for answering storage accounting questions such as how many blocks are free, how many inodes are used, and what percentage of total simulated capacity is occupied.
